scope: Independent static review of bounded CVC tool-build prerequisite. No foreign code executed by reviewer.

closed_findings.finding: Compiler manifest was hashed then parsed from a separate read.
closed_findings.fix: parse_manifest hashes and parses the same byte buffer; capture checks exact expected identity again before import. Regression rejects substituted bytes.

closed_findings.finding: A successful compiler exit could retain ignored warnings while runtime smoke passed.
closed_findings.fix: One diagnostic_free gate rejects compiler/runtime warning/error markers and stderr. Invalid-syntax oracle requires numeric nonzero exit, exact invalid.v(1) location plus semantic syntax/expression text; no output executable.

closed_findings.finding: Outer stderr was retained but did not prevent pass.
closed_findings.fix: Final exit/report gate now also requires empty outer stderr.

closed_findings.finding: Upstream hexasm CC recipe omitted CVCCFLGS, so a broad C sanitizer claim was incomplete.
closed_findings.fix: UBSan trap/no-recovery flags are in the fixed CC command itself; source/runtime/hexasm invocations get them. Generated assembly remains explicitly outside C instrumentation.
